clips.title: The story
paras: Standing in the northwestern corner of Moonbrook, the Schoolhouse is a prominent building resembling a town hall with a small graveyard behind it. Originally erected to educate local children under headmaster Stalvan Mistmantle, it now stands derelict amidst the Defias occupation of Westfall.

Before Moonbrook fell to ruin and bandits, the community invested in the education of its youth by raising this grand schoolhouse. Stalvan Mistmantle, an educated scholar from the north, was invited to Westfall specifically to serve as its headmaster. In those brighter days, the hall bustled with students rather than thieves, standing as proof of Moonbrook's former prosperity. Now, the schoolhouse lies abandoned to the elements and infested with outlaws, while the weathered headstones of its rear cemetery silently oversee Westfall's steady decay.
